title: Body buzzing for no clear reason?
caption: Body buzzing for no clear reason? The sky is steady, more like a quiet morning than a storm, so there’s room to recoup, and little wired/tired pockets often ease when you cut extra input. Keep caffeine earlier and modest, take a brief unhurried walk, and use slow breathing with steady meals.
snapshot: Space weather reads calm and uneventful. Solar wind flows in a normal range. No solar flares or CMEs have been noted. The resonance baseline sits close to typical levels.
affects: A wired/tired feel may pop up in pockets, then fade when you lower input. Quiet conditions tend to reward slow breaths, light movement, and steady meals. Expect the body to find a calmer gear when you don’t stack stress.
playbook:
- Keep caffeine earlier and modest
- Take a brief outdoor walk without rushing
- Do three minutes of slow breathing
- Choose one or two must-dos, then stop
- Check local air quality and wind
